verdict.rationale: incident.io documents follow-ups that it tracks to completion. Its integration directory says follow-ups can be exported as GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues or Asana tickets, with changes synced back, and Insights answers follow-up questions for leadership oversight. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync, detailed docs on sync direction and field mapping beyond integration-directory blurbs, evidence for other trackers such as Jira or Linear.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker

citations.quote: Capture the work an incident leaves behind, and track it to completion.
Export follow-ups as GitHub Issues and we'll sync any changes.
Export follow-ups as GitLab Issues and we'll sync any changes.
Export and automatically sync your incident actions with tickets in Asana.
Answer pager load, out-of-hours paging, response time and follow-up questions from the dashboards Insights ships with.
